description: Perform a reliability analysis (Cronbach's alpha) on the five Agreeableness items (A1, A2, A3, A4, A5) using the loaded 'BFI25.csv' dataset. Item A1 is negatively keyed and must be reverse-scaled (scale is 1-6). Configure the analysis to show 'Cronbach's alpha (if item dropped)'. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/Agreeableness_Reliability.omv'. Create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/reliability_report.txt' with three lines: 1. The overall Cronbach's alpha (3 decimal places). 2. The highest possible alpha if one item is dropped (3 decimal places). 3. The name of the item to drop to achieve that higher alpha (or 'None').
